name: ดอยโป่งสะแยน

attrs.description:
Doi Pong Sanyan or Pong Sayaen is a high summit on the border of Khun Yuam & Mae Chaem districts which is suitable for hiking or camping on foot only via primarily a 4 km trail from a forest park in ban mai huai wai.
The elevation is estimated around 2005
